indicators.notes: Annual percentages of constant price GDP are year-on-year changes; the base year is country-specific.
Expressed in billions of national currency units.
Values are based upon GDP in national currency converted to U.S. dollars using the average official exchange rate reported by the IMF.

indicators.indicator_name: Gross domestic product per capita, current prices
indicators.notes: GDP is expressed in current U.S. dollars per person. Data are derived by first converting GDP in national currency to U.S. dollars and then dividing it by total population.
The GDP deflator is derived by dividing current price GDP by constant price GDP and is considered to be a measure of general inflation.
Expressed as a ratio of total investment in current local currency and GDP in current local currency.
Consumer price indexes (CPI) reflect changes in the cost of acquiring a fixed basket of goods and services by the average consumer.

indicators.indicator_name: Volume of imports of goods and services
indicators.notes: Annual percentages of constant price imports of goods and services are year-on-year changes.

indicators.indicator_name: Volume of exports of goods and services
indicators.notes: Annual percentages of constant price exports of goods and services are year-on-year changes.
Unemployment rate can be defined by either the national definition or the ILO standard.
Revenue consists of taxes, social contributions, grants receivable, and other revenue.
Total expenditure consists of total expense and the net acquisition of nonfinancial assets.
Net lending (+)/borrowing (−) is calculated as revenue minus total expenditure.
Gross debt consists of all liabilities that require payment or payments of interest and/or principal by the debtor to the creditor.
Current account is all transactions other than those in financial and capital items. Data are expressed in billions of U.S. dollars.
Current account is all transactions other than those in financial and capital items. Expressed as a percent of GDP.
Population is based on the de facto definition, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
